test_optimize_rng_splitting: test that random.optimize_rng_use produces keys equivalent to jax.random.split(n) instead of sequential splits
test_rbg_default_impl: test that base.next_rng_key works correctly with the RBG default PRNG implementation
test_rbg_default_impl_invalid_key_shape: test that an invalid key shape raises a ValueError when using the RBG PRNG implementation
test_invalid_key: test that passing a non-RNG value to init raises a ValueError
test_custom_key: test that a custom PRNG implementation with a different key shape is accepted by Haiku
